exact_scalar_convention_witness.interpretation: Exact integer coefficients make the x^(p-1) coefficient vanish exactly. Canonical reduced representatives require the displayed nonzero x^p primitive term.

scope.all_j_theorem: For every j>=1, w_B(j,1)=E(F_j)L(F_j/(x-1))-L(F_j)E(F_j/(x-1)) is a nonzero rational number. Hence its formal five-divisor coefficient is nonzero modulo every prime outside a finite j-dependent exceptional set.
scope.not_proved: The constrained values T(a) coming from P0,P1 need not realize an arbitrary five-tuple; no actual-prime nonvanishing or density statement follows.
